author: Cleo Abram
description:
They just found something hidden in the Amazon… 

Researchers flew planes that shot lasers down into the forest. Some sneaks its way down and bounces back to the plane, revealing what’s hidden below.

They’ve only studied “less than 3%” of Amazonia, so to see what they find next, subscribe!

title: They Found Something Hidden In The Amazon
